theater: 漠北薛延陀牙帳與金山道

battle.name: 唐擊薛延陀之戰
battle.theater: 漠北薛延陀牙帳與金山道
battle.brief: 貞觀十五年正月，唐太宗以薛延陀吞併鐵勒諸部、屢侵西州為由，遣李勣、侯君集、李道宗分三道出塞，二月合兵追擊，於阿息山一帶大破之，斬首數千級，薛延陀諸部相率降附。卡面的斯巴達長矛是超長兵器在密集陣中頂住衝鋒的原型，雖未現於漠北戰場，唐軍步卒的長槊與陌刀卻承其緒餘；真正決定漠北勝負的仍是馬匹與弓弦。

kit.name: 斯巴達長矛
kit.history: 兩米長的木槍，槍尾帶銅套。方陣裡它比劍更早決定誰站得住。

countries: 交戰的兩方是唐與漠北的薛延陀。薛延陀是鐵勒諸部中勢力最盛的一支，活動於今蒙古中部到金山一帶，逐水草而居，以畜牧射獵為生，帳帳相望，控弦之眾常以萬計。鐵勒九姓在貞觀初年歸附唐室，被封為俟斤安置於漠南，薛延陀卻趁唐平定東突厥之際吞併同族，勢力向漠北擴張，並與西突厥往來密切。唐方在平定高昌、置安西都護府之後，視西域安危與鐵勒諸部的向背為一體：西州方向一旦被薛延陀與西突厥的勢力吞沒，唐在絲路南道的前線就無從防守。出兵體制上，貞觀十五年正月唐廷分道出塞，李勣為雲道行軍總管，侯君集與契苾何力率兵自涼州一道北出，李道宗為赤道行軍總管率輕騎自靈州出，各道總管銜名各書記載略有出入。漢兵之外有契苾何力等內蕃部眾隨行，軍中亦雜用降附的鐵勒騎兵。
countriesEn: The two sides were the Tang empire and the Xueyantuo of the northern steppe. The Xueyantuo were the strongest of the Tiele tribes, ranging from what is now central Mongolia to the Altai region, moving with the pastures, living by herding and hunting, their tents spread across the land and the men able to draw a bow numbered in the tens of thousands. The nine surnames of the Tiele had submitted to Tang in the early Zhenguan years and been invested as qijin in the southern steppe, but the Xueyantuo took advantage of Tang's destruction of the Eastern Turks to swallow up their own kindred, expanding northward and keeping close relations with the Western Turks. After defeating Gaochang and establishing the Protectorate at Xizhou, Tang judged the security of the Western Regions and the loyalty of the Tiele to be a single question: if the Xueyantuo and the Western Turks absorbed the western approach, Tang's forward line on the southern silk road could not be held. In the first month of the fifteenth year of Zhenguan the court marched in several columns, with Li Ji as overall commander of the Cloud Road, Hou Junji and the indigenous commander Qiebin Heli leading a column out of Liangzhou, and Li Daozong as overall commander of the Red Road taking light cavalry from Lingzhou; the exact titles of the column commanders differ slightly between sources. Besides Han troops, contingents of the Tiele under Qiebin Heli marched with the army, and surrendered Tiele horsemen were also used.
people: 唐太宗李世民是這場戰爭的決策者，詔令討薛延陀，罪狀是「頻為邊患」與「數侵西州」，而詔書同時保留羈縻與封賞的餘地，說明目標是打服而非滅國。雲道行軍總管李勣是全軍的樞紐，他老成持重，率主力大軍自雲中、朔方之間出塞，穩紮穩打，不求速進。赤道行軍總管李道宗自靈州率輕騎五千先行，孤軍深入，於途中遇薛延陀精騎而戰失利，士卒死傷慘重，僅以身免，這一敗反而成就了後續追擊的戰果。涼州一路的侯君集與內蕃都督契苾何力北行，與李勣會師，兩軍合而追擊，是最後一擊的執行者。敵方領袖薛延陀可汗在史書中名號記載不一，或稱咄毗可汗，其子嗣位後在部內失勢。戰後數年，薛延陀諸部因財物分配與部眾安置而互相攻伐，勢力迅速瓦解，唐廷乘機把殘餘諸部羈縻化，可汗的位子被架空，鐵勒的小首領被一一授官。
peopleEn: Emperor Taizong, Li Shimin, was the man who decided on this war, issuing the rescript that attacked the Xueyantuo on the counts of constant border trouble and repeated incursions against Xizhou, while deliberately leaving room for tribal reinstallation and rewards in the same document: the object was to subdue, not to destroy. Li Ji, overall commander of the Cloud Road, was the hinge of the whole operation; an old and steady general, he led the main body out between Yunzhong and Shuofang at a measured pace, never hurrying. Li Daozong, overall commander of the Red Road, went first with five thousand light cavalry out of Lingzhou, drove deep alone, met the Xueyantuo elite and was beaten, his men cut up and he barely escaped with his life, and that reverse in fact made the subsequent pursuit possible. Hou Junji and the indigenous commander Qiebin Heli, leading the Liangzhou column northward, joined Li Ji, and the two columns together carried out the final blow. The name of the Xueyantuo khan is given differently in the histories, sometimes as the Dupi khan, and after his son's accession he lost his grip within the camp. In the years after the battle the Tiele clans fell on one another over the distribution of spoils and the quartering of dependents, the confederacy dissolved quickly, and the Tang court used the moment to absorb the survivors into the tribal system, hollowing out the khanate and granting titles to the lesser Tiele leaders one by one.
kits: 卡面的斯巴達長矛是長矛的原型：兩米長的木杆，前端裝青銅矛頭，杆尾有銅套，重心偏後，既可刺也可支撐身體、格開來器，在密集的方陣裡替持盾者多爭一尺進退之地。這件兵器本身並未出現在貞觀十五年的漠北戰場——西元前八世紀的青銅矛頭在西域早已被鐵矛取代——但它所代表的那條戰術傳統在唐代仍在延續。唐軍步卒用長槊結陣，槊是丈餘長的木杆，前裝鐵刃，槊兵居前、弓弩居後，以超長兵器頂住對方騎兵的衝鋒；騎將則用長刀與長槊，陌刀一類長刀專為斬馬而制，能在騎兵掠過時把它連人帶馬砍落。馬鐙與馬鎧在唐軍裝備序列中已相當齊備，弓兵仍用胡弓與角弓，騎手立於鞍上以馬鐙借力發矢——這恰恰是薛延陀騎手最擅長的一門。漠北的會戰裡真正決定勝負的是馬匹、弓弦與耐寒的衣物，而不是矛尖的長短。
kitsEn: The dory on the card is the archetype of the long spear: a wooden shaft of two metres carrying a bronze head, with a bronze socket at the butt so that the weight sits low and the weapon can be used both to thrust and to brace the body and turn aside a blade, buying the shield man a foot of ground in a packed formation. The weapon itself never appeared on the northern steppe in 640: a bronze head of the eighth century BC had long been superseded by iron in the Western Regions. But the tactical tradition it stands for was still alive in the Tang. Tang foot soldiers formed up with long sao, a shaft of more than three metres tipped with an iron blade, the sao in front and the crossbows behind, using over-long weapons to absorb the charge of enemy horse; cavalry officers carried long sabres and sao of their own, and the miodao class of long blade existed precisely to cut horses down, striking rider and mount together in the moment of the pass. Stirrups and horse armour were well developed in the Tang inventory, and the archers still used the hu bow and the horn bow, loosing from the saddle with the stirrup to take the weight. That last art was exactly what the Xueyantuo riders did best. In a steppe battle the outcome is settled by horses, bowstrings and clothing that keeps out the cold, not by the length of a spearhead.
tactics: 唐軍的戰法是分道進擊、會師追殲。三路大軍同時出塞：雲道一路自雲中、朔方之間出，兵眾而穩，沿途不求速；涼州一路由侯君集與契苾何力率領，牽制薛延陀西面；靈州一路由李道宗率輕騎五千先行，目標直搗牙帳。走得最快的一支也最先遭敵，赤道軍深入後遇薛延陀精騎，戰不利，被迫退；雲道與涼州兩軍會合後不再分兵，循著李道宗退走的方向追擊，在阿息山（金山一帶，地點各書所記不一）追上敵軍主力，以大軍正面壓制、騎兵兩翼繞擊的配合破其陣，斬首數千級，俘虜與降附者以萬計。追擊得手之後，唐軍沒有在漠北長期駐紮，而是按詔令班師，把戰果換成薛延陀諸部的內部離心與唐廷的羈縻冊封。冬天的漠北養不住大軍，這一點唐太宗在 Moreau 之前的諸役中已經認清。
tacticsEn: Tang method was to march in several columns and converge for the kill. The three columns went out together: the Cloud Road column between Yunzhong and Shuofang, numerous and steady, pressing forward without haste; the Liangzhou column under Hou Junji and Qiebin Heli, holding the Xueyantuo from the west; the Lingzhou column under Li Daozong with five thousand light cavalry, sent to strike straight at the camp. The fastest column met the enemy first. The Red Road troops ran into Xueyantuo cavalry after pushing deep, were defeated and had to fall back; the Cloud Road and Liangzhou columns then joined and no longer split, following the track of the retreating light horse to catch the main body of the enemy in the region of Absin or the Altai, the precise site being given differently in the sources, and broke it with the weight of the main army pressing in front while cavalry struck the flanks, cutting down several thousand and taking prisoners and surrenders by the thousand. With the pursuit won, the Tang did not garrison the steppe. They returned by the terms of the rescript, converting the victory into the internal dissension of the Xueyantuo clans and into Tang investitures. The steppe in winter cannot feed a great army, and the Tang court had learned that lesson in the campaigns that came before.
data: 關於兵力的記載，通行說法稱唐軍出師十餘萬，其中李勣所率的雲道軍占了大部，赤道輕騎五千是最常被引用的確數，涼州一路的蕃兵人數沒有可靠記載。里程方面，雲中、朔方到薛延陀牙帳的距離，記文多以「深入大漠」「逾大漠數千里」形容，沒有可核的里數；可確定的是三路出發在正月至二月，正是漠北酷寒、草未回榮的時節，戰馬與人畜的給養全靠隨軍攜帶的乾糧、帳幕與備乘的瘦馬。斬殺與俘獲的數字，記文多作「斬首數千級」，俘獲降附則有「五萬餘口」之說，兩者互有出入，本文只取其概數而不作定論。戰役的時間跨度很短：出師到會師追擊不過數月，隨即班師。與其後在漠北長期屯駐、逐步設官的戰役性質不同，唐在薛延陀之戰中贏得的是一場會戰，而不是一次征服。
dataEn: On the numbers of men, the received account gives the Tang force as a little over a hundred thousand, with the greater part under Li Ji on the Cloud Road; the figure of five thousand light cavalry on the Red Road is the most commonly cited exact number, and no reliable count survives for the indigenous troops on the Liangzhou road. On distance, the stretch from Yunzhong and Shuofang to the Xueyantuo camp is described in the texts as pushing deep into the desert and crossing thousands of li of it, without a single verifiable figure; what can be fixed is the season, for the columns moved in the first and second months, when the steppe is bitterly cold and the grass has not yet come back, so the horses and the men lived entirely on grain, tents and remounts carried along. On losses, the texts usually give several thousand heads cut off, with a claim of fifty thousand prisoners and surrenders taken, the two figures not agreeing; only the rough shape is taken here. The whole operation was short. From the march out to the converging pursuit and the return took no more than a few months. Unlike the later steppe campaigns in which Tang garrisoned and gradually set up offices, what was won here was a pitched battle, not a conquest.
cause: 唐伐薛延陀，理由疊了三層。第一是邊患：薛延陀吞併鐵勒諸部之後，控弦之眾增至數萬，掠奪漠南漠北其他部落的牲畜，屢次入寇，邊州多受其害，雁門、代州一線的屯戍為之繃緊。第二是西域：貞觀十四年唐滅高昌、置西州之後，西域的門戶在唐手裡，但薛延陀的勢力已抵近西域北緣，若讓它與西突厥聯成一體，安西都護府就時刻受威脅，唐廷必須在上游先把它壓回去。第三是唐在草原上的根本政策：鐵勒諸部是唐對付突厥的主要助力，一個服從的薛延陀比一個消滅的薛延陀更有用，因為它可以成為北方邊防的前沿。於是太宗以「數侵西州、頻為邊患」詔討之，同時在詔書中保留羈縻與封賞之意：這場戰爭從一開始就以打服為目標，而不是以絕滅為目標，唐朝的胃口止於草原秩序的重新編排。
causeEn: Three layers of reason lay behind the Tang attack on the Xueyantuo. The first was border trouble: after swallowing up the other Tiele clans, the Xueyantuo had grown to tens of thousands of bowmen, took the livestock of neighbours north and south of the desert, and raided again and again, keeping the frontier prefectures of the Yanmen and Dai commanderies permanently alarmed. The second was the Western Regions: with Gaochang destroyed and Xizhou established in the fourteenth year of Zhenguan, the western gate was in Tang's hands, but the Xueyantuo had already reached the northern edge of the oasis belt, and if it joined with the Western Turks into a single power, the Protectorate at Xizhou would live under permanent threat; the court had to push it back from upstream first. The third was Tang's basic policy on the steppe: the Tiele were the chief instrument Tang used against the Turks, and a submissive Xueyantuo was worth more than an annihilated one, because it could serve as the forward shield of the northern defence. Taizong therefore declared war on the counts of repeated incursions against Xizhou and constant border trouble, while keeping room in the rescript for tribal reinstallation and reward. From the outset the object was to bring the Xueyantuo to heel, not to destroy it; Tang's appetite reached no further than a new arrangement of the steppe order.
impact: 薛延陀之戰的效果是立威而非滅國。唐軍大破之後，薛延陀諸部相率降附，朝廷於次年遣使來朝，重新承認唐在漠北的宗主地位；鐵勒諸部由此確認，唐能夠在最不利的季節深入漠北作戰，突厥與薛延陀一時都不敢再南下擾邊。更深一層的影響在薛延陀內部：大敗之後，其可汗與部眾在財物分配上起了爭執，諸部相攻，親族相殘，勢力在數年之內迅速瓦解，到貞觀二十年前後，其地已由唐設羈縻州縣，安北都護府與燕然、瀚海等都督府的輪廓在漠南漸次成形，鐵勒諸部的小首領被一一授予官號，成為唐在北方的屏障。唐廷同時在漠南設羈縻府州，與冊封、互市並行，把草原上的權力關係轉成可以年年重訂的儀式。從更長的視角看，這一戰把唐的影響力直接推到了金山與阿爾泰一帶，此後唐與西突厥爭奪北亞草原主導權，雙方都要拿鐵勒與薛延陀的殘部作棋子，草原上的權力關係因此被徹底改寫。
impactEn: The effect of the Xueyantuo war was a demonstration of force rather than annihilation. After the defeat the clans of the Xueyantuo came in one after another, and the following year their envoys came to court, once more acknowledging Tang as the overlord of the northern steppe. The Tiele learned that Tang could carry an army deep into the desert in the least favourable season, and for a time neither the Turks nor the Xueyantuo dared raid south again. The deeper consequence lay inside the Xueyantuo confederacy itself: after the rout, the khan and his men fell out over the distribution of property, the clans attacked one another and kinsmen destroyed kinsmen, and the power dissolved within a few years. By around the twentieth year of Zhenguan the land had been reorganised as Tang tribal prefectures and counties; the outline of the Protectorate General to Pacify the North and of the Yanran and Hanhai commanderies took shape along the southern steppe, and the lesser Tiele leaders were granted titles one by one, becoming the shield of Tang's northern defence. Seen from farther back, this battle pushed Tang's influence directly to the Altai, and in the struggle that followed between Tang and the Western Turks for mastery of the northern steppe, both sides played the Tiele and the remnants of the Xueyantuo as pieces. The relations of power on the steppe were rewritten.
result: 貞觀十五年，唐軍三道會師追擊，在阿息山一帶大破薛延陀，斬首數千級，俘獲及降附者以萬計，隨即班師。薛延陀沒有被消滅，卻被打掉了擴張的元氣：可汗的威信受損，諸部離心，與西突厥的關係也不再穩固，邊州得以喘息。數年之後，薛延陀在內訌與唐的持續打壓下崩解，其地在唐的羈縻體系中被重新編排，鐵勒諸部以小而服，汗位以虛而尊。對唐而言，此役的意義不在滅國，而在於確定了草原秩序的新框架：以最小的駐軍換取最大的緩衝，北方邊境在此後數十年維持了大體安寧，直到草原形勢在七世紀末發生新的變化。唐廷沒有在漠北留下大軍，只留下官號、盟約與互市的名目，草原上的秩序便以這樣輕的方式維持了數代人之久。
resultEn: In the fifteenth year of Zhenguan the three columns of the Tang army converged, pursued and routed the Xueyantuo in the region of Absin, cutting off several thousand and taking prisoners and surrenders by the thousand, and then returned. The Xueyantuo were not destroyed, but the vigour of their expansion was broken: the khan's authority was shaken, the clans fell apart, ties with the Western Turks grew uncertain, and the frontier prefectures could breathe again. Within a few years the confederacy collapsed under internal feuding and continued Tang pressure, and its lands were reorganised inside the Tang tribal system, the small Tiele clans submissive, the khanate hollow. For Tang the significance of the campaign lay not in destroying a people but in fixing a new frame for the order of the steppe: the smallest possible garrison buying the largest possible buffer. The northern border enjoyed a general peace for the following decades, until the situation on the steppe changed again in the closing years of the seventh century.
